h1: AI Team Headshots That Match Across the Page
lead: A team page looks unfinished when portraits are framed and lit differently. Upload the approved photos together and get matching AI team headshots.

steps.d: Upload a clear photo of the face and shoulders, in even light, with nothing on the face. The person must agree before you upload.
Set one background, one crop (how tight the face is), one light, and one clothes note. Reuse it. Keep each person's own face.
Download the set for the page or a slide deck. Keep names in text beside each portrait.

maker.upload_title: Drop a photo of the person here

faq.q: What is an AI team headshot?
faq.a: A square portrait from an approved photo, with a background, framing, and light you can reuse for every teammate. Framing means how the face is cut. Each person keeps their own features. It is not an ID card or a passport photo.
A recent photo of the face and shoulders, in even light, with no hat, sunglasses, or hand covering the face. Use a photo that person has approved for the company to upload.

faq.q: How can the team page feel consistent?
faq.a: Share one background, one framing, and one light across every portrait, while each person keeps their own features. Write that setup once and reuse it, including for the whole set at once.

faq.q: Can I put names inside the headshot?
faq.a: Add names and job titles as text beside each image. Keeping them out of the portrait makes a role change a text edit, not a new photo. A caption belongs on a short intro clip, not inside the photo.

faq.q: Will this match a specific person exactly?
faq.a: No. It follows the features visible in the uploaded photo. It is still a made portrait, not a camera photo, and not an ID card. Have that person review it before you publish.

faq.q: What does a team headshot cost?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed photo returns those credits. The download has no watermark, so our name is not stamped on the file. You can use it in your own ads, pages, and posts. Plan sizes are listed on [AIVideosUGC pricing](page:pricing).

faq.q: Do I need permission from each teammate?
faq.a: Yes. Upload only a photo the person agreed you can use for this business purpose, and let them approve the final portrait.

faq.q: Can a new hire match an existing set?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same background, framing, and light on the new hire's approved photo. You do not reshoot the rest of the team.

faq.q: Can I use the portraits in a pitch deck?
faq.a: Yes. The square file can sit on an About page, a profile, or a slide. Keep contact details as text next to the image.

faq.q: Can a short intro have a voice, captions, and music?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the portraits as photos, and add an AI voice, captions, and background music on a short intro clip beside them. You can post that clip to TikTok, or to Meta (Facebook and Instagram), or download it. The portrait is not a customer quote.

faq.q: Can my own software send the team photos?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your own software send approved photos when a staff page needs the same framing. Each photo still needs that person's permission, and each one shows its credit cost first.
